description: This file defines classes and functions related to trace model backends, including ZIP and fetch-based implementations, for handling trace data in a web environment.

classes.name: ZipTraceModelBackend
classes.description: Handles trace data from ZIP files using zip.js library.

classes.name: FetchTraceModelBackend
classes.description: Handles trace data fetched directly via HTTP requests.

classes.name: TraceViewerServer
classes.description: Provides server-side functionalities for reading files and generating URLs.

methods.name: isLive
methods.description: Indicates whether the backend is live; ZIP backend returns false, fetch backend returns true.

methods.name: traceURL
methods.description: Returns the trace URL associated with the backend.

methods.name: entryNames
methods.description: Retrieves list of entry names in the trace data.

methods.name: hasEntry
methods.description: Checks if a specific entry exists.

methods.name: readBlob
methods.description: Reads entry data as a Blob.

methods.name: _readEntry
methods.description: Internal method to fetch a Response object for an entry.

methods.name: getFileURL
methods.description: Generates a URL for a given file path.

methods.name: readFile
methods.description: Fetches a file response from the server.
